handle.formatError: Letters without accents, digits, “_” or “-”, 3 to 30 characters.
handle.saved: Address saved: share it with your customers.
handle.title: Your page address
handle.sub: A short link to share with your customers (WhatsApp, business cards, social media).
handle.rule: Can be changed once every 30 days. The old address still leads to your page. Brand names are reserved for their owners.
page.title: Custom seller page
page.sub: Cover photo and links to your website and social media, shown on your public profile.
title: Settings & notifications
intro.short: Profile, alerts, hand-overs and account security.
intro.long: Manage your seller details, contact preferences, account security and transaction alerts.
profile.title: Public seller profile
profile.sub_one: Visible to buyers on your {{count}} live listing.
profile.sub_other: Visible to buyers on your {{count}} live listings.
profile.phoneLoginHint: You sign in with it: changing it requires your password.
profile.emailConfirmHint: A confirmation link will be sent to it when you save.
profile.pwForEmail: Required to change your email address
alerts.title: Notifications & alerts
alerts.sub: Choose how and when you want to hear about sales opportunities.
push.subscribed: Push notifications are on for this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in the browser — allow them in its settings.
push.ios: On iPhone, add Dilchap to your home screen to get notifications.
push.off: Push notifications are not on for this device.
alerts.footnote: Push and email follow these choices (at most one email a day for pending messages); WhatsApp/SMS to your verified number, only for messages, offers, hand-overs and disputes (one SMS per conversation at a time): boosts, tips and campaigns never send any. Security emails and purchase receipts are always sent.
quiet.title: Quiet hours (Do not disturb)
quiet.on: Push notifications and WhatsApp / SMS alerts held between {{start}} and {{end}} (local time), then sent when quiet hours end.
quiet.off: Off: push notifications arrive at any time. WhatsApp / SMS alerts are still held at night, from {{start}} to {{end}} (local time).
handover.title: Hand-over spots & payment methods
handover.sub: Set your safe meet-up points and your direct payment channels.
handover.spotsHint: Suggested to buyers when setting up a meet-up:
handover.commissionNote: Dilchap takes no commission on your direct transactions. 100% of the agreed price goes to you. Our revenue comes only from promotion options (Boosts).
security.title: Security & sign-ins
security.sub: Keep an eye on access to your account and your identity checks.
security.kycValidated: Approved on {{date}} by the Dilchap team.
security.kycPrompt: Send a photo of your ID and a selfie: it is required for the “Verified account” and “Certified seller” badges.
security.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters, different from your other accounts.
security.sessions: Sessions and devices currently signed in
account.title: Account management & danger zone
account.sub: Pause your sales or close your Dilchap profile.
account.vacationHint_one: Instantly hides your {{count}} listing from search results without losing your favourites or reviews.
account.vacationHint_other: Instantly hides your {{count}} listings from search results without losing your favourites or reviews.
account.tourHint: Go over the Dilchap essentials again, and the new features already shown.
account.deleteHint: Your listings are removed, your personal data erased and all your sessions closed.
aside.rule1: Always arrange hand-overs in well-lit public places (shopping centres, petrol stations…).
aside.rule2: Encourage instant Mobile Money payment on the spot once the buyer has checked the item.
aside.rule3: Never deliver without a deposit in isolated places.
aside.reactivityHint: Share of conversations opened by buyers that you replied to. Responsive sellers sell much faster.
delete.title: Delete my account
delete.withPassword: This cannot be undone. Confirm with your password.
delete.noPassword: This cannot be undone. Your account has no password: a sign-in less than 30 minutes old confirms it.
personalize.title: Personalise my home page
personalize.on: The home page (“Top picks”, “For you”) and the “Relevance” sort adapt to the listings you view, favourite or search for. Clearing your history resets this profile.
personalize.off: Off: everyone sees the same home page for your town, and nothing from your views is kept for ranking.
